system.description:
The enchantment must be worked in with the blood. It weighs like an average mask for inventory purposes (0.25lbs) but it feels twice the weight if worn by non-evil individuals.

This mask appears like a skinless face with black holes for eyes. Attuning to it requires the facial flesh of a freshly killed creature. By affixing the facial skin of a victim to the mask’s surface and completing attunement, the wearer can assume the victim’s appearance. They instantly know the victim’s language, mannerisms and posture, and have surface level recognition of people and situations the victim was familiar with. The wearer instantly copies all about the victim except their clothing. It will hold up to physical examination, but not against spells such as Truesight.

Creatures who knew the victim and interact with the wearer for more than 10 consecutive minutes, can make an Insight check against the wearer’s Deception to discover the ruse. Strangers who have no reason to suspect duplicity have disadvantage on the check.

If the wearer is killed or attunement ends, the mask reverts to its original state.
system.craftingComponents: Wood chips, bone dust, water, half a pint of humanoid blood, gut strings (catgut strings were generally made for musical instruments, but these would not come from a cat)
